narr: A stalled boundary across the region, combined with an influx of moisture and humid airmass, led to afternoon showers and thunderstorms across eastern Kentucky. These storms resulted in heavy rainfall, which caused flash flooding in portions of Laurel County. Another storm resulted in strong wind gusts and downed trees in Letcher County.
ev: Highway 192, near the U.S. Post Office, had approximately 6 inches of water flowing over the road in southern London. Water receded by 9 PM EDT.
A portion of 1-75 was flooded between mile marker 36 and 41 in northern London.
